about.title: Beyond the Interface
about.subtitle: Engineering resilient software architectures and orchestrating data streams
about.bioParagraph1: Full Stack Developer passionate about robust software architecture and system engineering. My technical foundation has been shaped through modular REST API design, relational database schema optimization, and responsive interface development.
about.bioParagraph2: Currently pursuing a Master 1 in Data Engineering at Groupe 3iL, I am actively expanding my horizon toward large-scale data pipelines (ETL/ELT), hybrid storage architectures (SQL/NoSQL), and containerized infrastructure.
about.domain1Desc: MVC/modular architectures, secure REST APIs, strict static typing with TypeScript, NestJS, Angular, React, and Laravel.
about.domain2Desc: Learning data processing pipelines (ETL/ELT), relational & NoSQL data modeling, and analytical querying with Python and SQL.
about.domain3Desc: Docker containerization, multi-tier caching strategies (Redis, database caching), continuous integration, and deployment reliability.
